verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents headless, programmatic access: an official CLI for managing apps, a SQL API to submit, check and cancel statements, and REST APIs explicitly aimed at end-to-end automation. No evidence covers CI pipeline integration, non-interactive or service authentication for CI runners, or exit-code and scripting behavior, so headless operation is documented but CI use is only implied. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples), documented non-interactive auth for automated runners, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Snowflake REST APIs suite of APIs enables developers to build end-to-end automation and integration with Snowflake resources.
Submit SQL statements for execution. Check the status of the execution of a statement. Cancel the execution of a statement.
With Snowflake CLI, developers can create, manage, update, and view apps running on Snowflake
Manage your deployment (e.g. provision users and roles, create tables, etc.)
